definition.summary: Among the rarest and highest-level Mystic Eyes, allowing the holder to see the death of all things; the source frames it as understanding and connecting to death itself, directly related to the Root, not merely a killing ability.

visualSurface.label: 死之线
visualSurface.effectRaw: cutting along them with a blade ignores physical strength and defense and directly kills

visualSurface.label: 死之点
visualSurface.visualRaw: beginning and endpoint of an object's existence
visualSurface.effectRaw: stabbing with a blade erases the object's existence; higher application

acquisitionCondition.summary: Requires a special near-death experience in the general summary; original Shiki's profile gives a near-death awakening after shielding Akiha.

holdersInCurrentSource.scopeNote: Holder list only; no Ryougi details are extracted in this packet.

limitationsAndCautions.summary: Shiki wears Mystic Eye Killer glasses to suppress the eyes and reduce brain burden.
Nanaya Shiki formal ownership is not supported by this packet because the source states later author comment says he does not have Direct Death Mystic Eyes.
